_how: The song menu. The person picks a sound by its label; you never show the style text. For 'berlin', pick (or let them pick) a world that fits the news and fill WORLD and PERCUSSION. Send style and exclude to Suno exactly as built.
exclude: ballad, slow tempo, long intro, instrumental intro, sung verses, male lead vocal, rap, whisper, mumbling, trance, dubstep, lo-fi, musical theatre, sad

sounds.label: 🔊 Berlin techno + a world from the past that fits the news (Klaudia's signature sound)
sounds.style: Berlin warehouse techno meets WORLD; short and catchy, fast and relentless 136 BPM four-on-the-floor; starts immediately with the voice, no long intro: a dry deadpan spoken line over almost no music, then a hard beat drop; PERCUSSION as percussion, rolling bass; cold deadpan spoken female verses, rapid-fire, gang-shouted answers; punchy shouted chorus, call-and-response; the music cuts dead for one dry spoken last line by a real human woman; clear, intelligible vocals, loud and upfront

worlds.PERCUSSION: cash-register dings, a clicking tally counter, studio applause and ringing telethon phones
square-wave arcade leads, game-over jingles, joystick clicks and laser zaps
worlds.fits: games, apps, tech, jobs and AI

worlds.PERCUSSION: scissor snips, splicing-tape rips, clattering film reels and projector clicks
ticker-tape clatter, an opening bell, shouting traders and rubber stamps
worlds.fits: business, companies, markets (never a coin or a token)

worlds.PERCUSSION: countdown beeps, radio static, rocket rumble and switch clicks
typewriter bells, teleprinter chatter, flash-bulb pops and a ringing desk phone

sounds.label: 📻 1950s radio jingle, doo-wop girl group (happy, historic news)
sounds.style: 1950s radio jingle, doo-wop, female duet, girl group close harmony vocals, female announcer, swing, upright bass, vibraphone, theremin, space age, vintage AM radio, triumphant; short, starts immediately with the announcer's voice, no long intro; clear, intelligible vocals, loud and upfront

sounds.label: ✨ Surprise me
sounds.style: choose 'berlin' with the world that fits the news best, and say which
